{"subject":"things a family visiting for a few days can turn up to with young children: museums, zoos, aquariums, playgrounds","town":"New York, NY","stage":"preschool","window":"September 12 to 15"}

content.text:
I found two places a preschooler can visit, both with hours on their own pages. I couldn't confirm anything for September 12 to 15 itself. What follows is each venue's regular posted hours.

**1. Children's Museum of Manhattan (CMOM)**
- **Age fit:** 
its exhibits and programs are for children ages 0-6
.
- **When:** 
Tuesday–Sunday, 10 am–5 pm
. Its FAQ page lists 
Monday–Sunday, 10 am–5 pm for July–September
. That page is older and conflicts with the current hours, so I couldn't confirm whether it's open on a Monday such as Sept 14.
- **Daily programs:** 
Circle Time at 10:30 am, then Mural Wall or Messy with Art at 11:15 am
.
- **Price:** I didn't find a current admission price on their pages. 
They say you save $1 when you book online.

- **Source:** Children's Museum of Manhattan.

**2. Central Park Zoo (includes the Tisch Children's Zoo)**
- **Age fit:** the zoo's rate table lists 
Child (3 - 12) at $16.95 and Child (2 & under) free
.
- **When:** their site lists 
April 2 — October 31, 2026: Mon-Fri 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM, weekends 10:00 AM - 5:30 PM
. 
Last entry is 1 hour before closing.

- **Tickets:** 
Same-day tickets are available for online purchase, subject to availability.

- **Source:** Central Park Zoo (Wildlife Conservation Society).

**Not included:** The New York Aquarium's own page lists 
hours from September 8, 2026, opening at 10:00am
, with 
a posted last entry time
. I didn't find an age range on its page, so I've left it out as a pick.

I didn't get to playgrounds, so there are none here.
